player_prompt.intro:
Oli Muzanyi {player_id}. Oli muzanya omuzanyo gw'ekitoone kya 15-Puzzle.
Ekigendererwa ky'omuzanyo kwe kukola matayiro agawuliddwa mu mpangiso ya nambari okuva 1 okutuuka 15, n'ekitundu eky'ali kituusibwamu kisangibwe mu makkati g'ekibinja ky'ebali emabega.
Okusobola okufuula, oyinza kusogga tayiro limu mu kitundu eky'ali kituusibwamu (ekiragiddwa na dubbulu andabika, e.g. __) nga oyita mu lugendo lwa kufuula kuliko:
- 'up': Sogga tayiro eri wansi wa kitundu eky'ali kituusibwamu okudda waggulu.
- 'down': Sogga tayiro eri waggulu wa kitundu eky'ali kituusibwamu okudda wansi.
- 'left': Sogga tayiro eri ku mabbali wa kitundu eky'ali kituusibwamu okudda ku mabbali wa kkono.
- 'right': Sogga tayiro eri ku mabbali wa kkono wa kitundu eky'ali kituusibwamu okudda ku mabbali wa kulia.
Okusobola okuteeka lugendo lwo, tiiypa lugendo (e.g., 'up', 'down', 'left', oba 'right') mu mbawo za mraba, e.g. [up].
Ekibinja ekya sasa kya matayiro kya muzanyo kikulagiddwa wansi. Oyinza kutayambulira ku kibinja kino okutataganya omuzanyo.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Enkola y'okutambula ebadde terina makulu. Omuzannyi {player_id} teyanukudde na ngeri entuufu mu bbeere erya square brackets.
invalid_move.illegal_move: Ekikolwa kikyamu. Akapande tekasobola kusengulwa mu kkubo eryalagiddwa.

outcome.win: Mwebale nnyo! Omuzannyi {player_id} mumalirizza bulungi ekizibu kya 15.
outcome.turn_limit: Ekigero ky'okukyusa kituuse. Ekifaananyi kiwedde {percent} ku buli kikumi eky'ekikangabwa
